notes: Genelec 8341A is a 3-way coaxial "The Ones" series active/smart studio monitor with Intelligent Signal Sensing (auto-switches between analog XLR and AES/EBU digital input; AES/EBU input can loop-through to the AES/EBU output for daisy-chaining a digital chain). The two RJ45 ports are GLM control-network connectors (not audio-bearing Ethernet data ports) used to daisy-chain Genelec Loudspeaker Manager (GLM) calibration/control between units and a network interface; no bandwidth grade is published for them so no "grade" field was set. No bandwidth/version grade applies to the XLR analog or AES/EBU connectors either, per the grading rules (AES3 is not in the gradable connector list). Power inlet connector type (IEC C13/C14) is inferred from standard Genelec practice for this product line — the official spec page lists mains voltage/consumption but does not explicitly name the inlet connector type, so this is a medium-confidence detail within an otherwise high-confidence, manufacturer-sourced spec set. Dimensions 351 x 237 x 243 mm, weight 9.8 kg, desktop/stand-mounted monitor (not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted).
